report_discrepancies.note: Governmental funds Total column: 1,747,478 + 938,120 - 507,688 = 2,177,910 vs printed ending fund balance 2,177,909 (printed net change 430,431; fund columns' ending balances add to 2,177,910). Rounding in the report.
Street Fund Total revenues printed 109,937; lines 20,742 + 29,561 + 50,891 + 1,569 + 7,172 = 109,935.
Sales tax Fund Total revenues printed 68,232; lines 56,375 + 1,788 + 10,068 = 68,231.

General Fund departments schedule: department revenue cells add to 759,953 vs printed Total revenues 759,951 (General property tax row cells 164,854 vs 164,853; State assistance 114,989 vs 114,988; Other revenues 347,104 vs 347,105; General column 263,728 vs 263,726). Rounding in the report.

General Fund departments schedule Total column prints no Supplies total and its Total operating expenses 152,710 excludes Supplies (department cells 37,591; department Total operating expenses add to 190,300); Total Expenditures 410,300 equals all department cells. Personnel services cells add to 117,436 vs Total 117,435.

Proprietary Total column: operating revenue lines 1,499,936 + 559,830 + 19,243 = 2,079,009 vs printed Total operating revenues 2,079,008 (operating loss (51,745) and the net position roll-forward agree with 2,079,009). Rounding in the report.

Electric Fund operating expense lines add to 1,671,055 vs printed 1,671,054; G&A row cells 132,022 vs Total 132,021; Miscellaneous cells 16,399 vs 16,400; Sales Curtis cells 1,499,937 vs 1,499,936. Rounding in the report.

Statement of Net Position: business-type asset lines add to 4,521,228 vs printed Total assets 4,885,899 (Totals column lines 7,374,870 vs 7,739,541). The gap equals the notes receivable (current 33,000 + noncurrent 331,670 = 364,670, p5) that the government-wide statement omits as a line. Also total liabilities lines 983,513 vs printed 983,512 and business-type net position lines 3,908,125 vs printed 3,908,126 (rounding).

Proprietary Statement of Cash Flows Total: net flows 101,040 - 70,334 + 105,703 + 75,556 = 211,965 vs printed net increase 211,966; the reconciliation (p9) prints net cash from operating activities 101,265 (Sewer 5,029, using operating loss (17,633)) vs 101,040 on p8.

notes: Basic statements p1-9 (government-wide Statement of Net Position and Activities, governmental funds Balance Sheet and Revenues/Expenditures, proprietary statements and cash flows); recorded as GAAP-structured (fund balance roll-forward), as FY2023, although the General Fund departments schedule (p11) is titled 'modified cash basis'. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p4); no transfers or adjustments printed this year. Business-type from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position Total column (p7); no restatement; transfers between enterprise funds appear only in the cash flow statement (net 0). Business-type disbursements total 2,146,088 printed on the Statement of Activities (p2) = operating 2,130,754 + interest 15,334. Ending cash = governmental funds Balance Sheet cash + cash held by County Treasurer; CDs 597,975 in ending_investments; beginning cash not shown. 'MEAN distribution' recorded as other (no page evidence of reimbursement; the Statement of Activities counts it in 'Other receipts'). Grants (Library 3,643) recorded as category other / detail Grants (grantor not printed). Detail: General Fund departments combining schedule (p11), one line per department column; Street and Sales tax funds one line per fund column of p4; enterprise funds per fund column of p7 (no utility budget schedules). The all-funds budgetary-basis budget-and-actual schedule (p10) is not recorded (all funds combined in one column; would double count). Many printed totals differ by $1-2 from their lines (report rounding), recorded in report_discrepancies. Read pages 1-11 of 11
